content: These references include studies on the efficacy of different antibiotics, such as ceftriaxone, azithromycin, spectinomycin, and cefixime, in treating uncomplicated gonorrhea, pharyngeal gonorrhea, and other related infections. The studies also explore treatment failures, antimicrobial resistance, and comparisons of single-dose therapies versus alternative regimens. Additionally, some references discuss the implications of STI treatment on HIV transmission risk, patient preferences, and cost-effectiveness analyses.
